column1: # Curated seed grounds (Phase B Group 6 importer).
# A deliberately tiny set of well-known international venues used as reference
# data until real provider venue registers are ingested. Imported by
# `manage.py import_cricsheet_register` when no --venues file is given (each
# row also seeds a Ground under the venue).
# country_iso must exist in the seeded `country` table (venues.0002); timezone
# must be a valid IANA timezone id (validate_iana_timezone).
